description: The spec II.10 constants and data provenance table, serialised by GET /v1/citation for any run (spec IV.6). Spec II.10 states the rule of construction: any number that appears in a result and is not computed from this table is a bug. The table therefore lives in configuration rather than in source. A row whose runtime_key names a field of the run has that field substituted in, because the table records which quantity is dynamic and the run records what it was.
source: spec II.10 requirement 1 compliance record, transcribed row by row
